settings.heading: Wear Your Presence.
settings.text: BANISHQ is a modern Indian unisex label. We make clothes that amplify who you already are, and we price them so that is not a luxury.

settings.heading: Premium make should not cost four times what it is worth.
settings.text:
Most of what you pay for a well-made shirt in India is not the shirt. It is the layers between the cutting table and the shelf. We removed them: we manufacture what we sell, we photograph it ourselves, and we sell it directly to you.

What is left is the part that matters — heavier fabric, cleaner cuts, and sizing that behaves the same across every style.
